name: Yukarin no Chousen
source:
A country bumpkin girl insists on stripping naked in public.

Exposure play of a rural lolita, embarrassed but compelled.
She gets caught by a boy in class, does slavery play in the park at night,
hooks up with the neighbor... she's a free spirit, broken headed,
sexually promiscuous. It's Yukarin! What will she do next? 

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE080371.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个乡下女孩偏要当众脱光衣服。

农村萝莉的露出游戏：明明害羞，却又无法抗拒。
她被班上一名男生撞见，夜里在公园玩奴隶调教，
又与邻居勾搭……她自由奔放、脑袋不太正常、
性生活混乱。她就是由香里！接下来又会做出什么？
